# Downloads

Built jars, committed so there is a direct download link.

**Latest:** `birchoptimizer-2.0.0.jar`

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API and Java 25.
Drop the jar in your `mods/` folder.

Only the current build is kept here — replace it rather than adding a second
copy, so the repository does not accumulate binaries.
